stem: Which sentence could BEST follow sentence 26 to support the ideas in the sixth paragraph (sentences 24–26)?

options.label: A
options.text: Congress wanted to ensure that the country had a government powerful enough to defeat Great Britain if necessary.

options.label: B
options.text: Later the city of Philadelphia would be recognized as the temporary capital of the United States of America.

options.label: C
options.text: Here, they began the work of hammering out a more detailed and effective plan for the government of the United States.

options.label: D
options.text: They wanted to help improve the articles since Washington did not think they were sufficient for the country.
